observations: The article first compares elementary CASSCF/TST rate coefficients against available experimental values and reports that most calculated rates are smaller than experiment.
The article then proposes a master-equation treatment combining coupled-cluster-corrected DFT energetics with long-range transition-state treatment.
The authors explicitly state that this MESMER modeling was performed on systems for which experimental data were available and for which canonical CCSD(T)-F12a calculations were feasible.
The resulting MESMER rates are described as generally closer to experimental values than the CASSCF/TST rates, with the experimental ordering reproduced.
The article states that quantitative product branching still requires substantial further work.
new_primary_source_evidence.evidence_scope: These statements establish that experimental data were available during construction/evaluation of the MESMER modeling path. They do not, by themselves, prove that any individual MESMER collision, energy-transfer, density-of-states, long-range, or PES parameter was numerically fitted to the CH3O2 target rate.

calibration_firewall_reason: A later independent comparator can establish temporal independence from the published PES, but it cannot make an earlier experiment-aware master-equation model automatically independent of the older data used during model construction or evaluation.

The frozen family-independence rule prohibits using a target that participated in fitting or target-informed model selection as independent validation unless that target is quarantined as calibration.

Because the main article explicitly conditions the MESMER modeling set on availability of experimental data and evaluates model quality by closeness to experiment, the exact SI S5 parameter-selection lineage must be reconstructed before any MESMER output is licensed as an independent predicted-rate comparator.

supporting_information_status.section_required: SI section S5 and Table S5
supporting_information_status.inference_policy: No claim is made that calibration occurred, and no claim is made that it did not occur, until the exact model inputs and selection lineage are inspected.

next_gate: Recover SI section S5 and Table S5 in an inspectable form.

Enumerate the exact MeO2+MeO2 MESMER temperature, pressure or pressure-independence treatment, bath gas, collision model, energy-transfer parameters, density-of-states treatment, long-range association treatment, PES energy source, and any fitted or manually selected quantities.
Determine whether any of those choices were fitted, tuned, screened, or selected using the same MeO2 experimental rate data summarized in the theory paper.
If same-target tuning occurred, quarantine the corresponding MESMER result as calibration and seek a prospectively independent prediction/observation pair.

If no same-target tuning occurred, retain the later Onel et al. direct kinetics as the independent comparator and proceed only after exact state-point and network representation matching is demonstrated.
Keep quantitative product branching as a separate unresolved gate even if the overall-rate provenance gate closes.
